name: mastery-learning
description: An AI teaching skill with a polished local HTML classroom, adaptive lessons, interactive labs, mastery checks, and spaced review.

interface.shortDescription: Beautiful HTML teaching with honest mastery and durable progress.
interface.longDescription: A local-first AI teaching system for programming, mathematics, machine learning, AI, and LLMs. Every teaching turn is rendered in a polished HTML classroom; the Coach plans adaptive lessons, builds interactive labs, coaches code, verifies transfer and delayed recall, schedules review, and keeps transparent learner-owned progress. This package is the tested Codex adapter for a platform-neutral teaching protocol.
defaultPrompt: Turn my learning goal into a compact plan and open my HTML classroom.
Continue from my local progress and handle due reviews first.
Teach this concept with an interactive lab and check transfer.
